cards.name: A Stainless Story

effects.printed_clause: Activate only while opponent controls more cards than you.
effects.lua_implementation: The activation condition compares total on-field group counts for both players.

official_references.matched_structure: Evenly Matched uses comparative field-card counts as activation/resolution logic.

effects.printed_clause: Send a Stain monster from your Deck or a face-up Stain in your opponent’s Deck to GY as the pre-semicolon action.
effects.lua_implementation: GLOBALFLAG_DECK_REVERSE_CHECK exposes face-up Deck cards; cost selection permits own Deck or only face-up opponent Deck Stain among the five summon-effect codes and sends with REASON_COST.

official_references.matched_structure: Parasite Paracide uses official face-up cards inside an opponent’s Deck and the global reverse-Deck check.

effects.printed_clause: This effect becomes that monster’s effect if it is Normal or Special Summoned.
effects.lua_implementation: The five currently eligible Main Deck Stain summon effects are manually mirrored; no dynamic monster-trigger object is invoked from the sent card.

official_references.matched_structure: Darklord Eveningstar uses CheckActivateEffect to obtain and execute another card’s target/operation.

official_references.card_name: Grapha, Dragon Overlord of Dark World
official_references.matched_structure: Grapha, Dragon Overlord of Dark World uses ChangeChainOperation for an effect that becomes another printed operation.

effects.issue: Confirmed as a custom-engine gap: CheckActivateEffect supports activatable Spell/Trap effects, but there is no official generic API that safely rebinds an arbitrary monster's Normal/Special Summon trigger, targets, metadata, and operation to this Spell's resolution.

effects.printed_clause: Banish this card from GY; each player draws 1.
effects.lua_implementation: A GY ignition banishes as cost, requires both players able to draw, then draws one for each.

official_references.matched_structure: Upstart Goblin supplies official draw operation; shared-player draw scripts call Duel.Draw separately for each player.

effects.printed_clause: You can only activate 1 "A Stainless Story" per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Only the card activation uses oath SetCountLimit; the GY effect is intentionally unrestricted by that activation-only sentence.

official_references.matched_structure: Pot of Desires uses an oath-style once-per-card-activation count limit.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed the existing dynamic summon-effect-copy limitation; the current five eligible Main Deck effects remain explicitly mirrored.

coverage_override.reason: The audit records split this card into its material/procedure, restrictions, activated or continuous operations, and printed count-limit clauses; no printed functional clause is omitted.
